zh: Open-AutoGLM 会话延续与意图自动路由：多轮对话中自动保持手机控制技能激活，免除每条消息手动输入 @ 标识。
复合指令智能编排与容错：支持“打卡设置/打开设置 截图看看”等操作+截屏复合任务，自动执行端到端手机任务并获取最新屏幕。
兼容通用工具别名调度（open_autoglm），防止模型调用泛化工具名时出现工具不可用异常。
en: Seamless Open-AutoGLM session persistence and intent auto-routing: maintain phone automation active across conversation turns without re-typing @ chips.
Compound instruction orchestration & typo tolerance: automatically execute tasks and take real-time screenshots for instructions like 'open settings & screenshot'.
Universal tool alias dispatch (open_autoglm) preventing tool unavailability when models call generic skill aliases.
